claim_ceiling: Exact polynomial nonidentifiability theorem for transverse completions of K419's finite rank-70 fixture. A constant-rank family and rank-jump families with coefficient 1-t^(N+1) share the same frozen map and can share arbitrarily long finite transverse jets, while the latter acquire a one-dimensional fiber relation and cokernel at t=1 without a global polynomial extra syzygy. K419's point data and K422's homogeneous-orbit transport therefore do not determine transverse rank behavior or nonlinear relations. The control families are not source-owned, prove no actual K77 rank jump or KT properness, construct no functional domain, and move no source, ledger, canon, paper, public, novelty or physical GU verdict.
